title: What if the Moon vanished?
assumptions: Impossible instantaneous removal; ignore energy and momentum consequences of removal
Qualitative effects; no claim of immediate climate catastrophe

sources.supports: Moon influence on Earth, tides and axial stability
sources.access_status: not_verified_in_this_environment; NASA request received proxy 403 on 2026-10-25

scenes.label: ONE IMPOSSIBLE CHANGE
scenes.text: What if the Moon vanished tonight? Imagine it disappears without debris or an explosion.

scenes.label: THE EARTH KEEPS TURNING
scenes.text: Earth would keep spinning. Losing the Moon would not suddenly switch off gravity or stop our orbit.

scenes.label: THE SUN STILL MAKES TIDES
scenes.text: Ocean tides would change, but they would not disappear. The Sun also pulls on the oceans.

scenes.label: DARKER NIGHTS
scenes.text: Nights without moonlight would look darker, changing a familiar cue for many living things.

scenes.label: LONG TIMESCALES MATTER
scenes.text: The Moon helps stabilize our axial tilt. Any long term consequences would need careful modeling.

scenes.label: CHANGE IS NOT INSTANT CHAOS
scenes.text: So the first surprise is not instant chaos. It is a missing light, followed by a changed world.
